print("=== VERIFICATION OF FINAL COLLECTION ===\n")

# Show what we kept after filtering
print("Items matching ALL criteria:")
print("  - color is NOT indigo")
print("  - size is NOT extra-extra-large") 
print("  - material is NOT steel")
print("  - smell is NOT vanilla")
print("  - origin is NOT Mexican\n")

matching_items_detail = []
for item in items:
    size, origin, name, material, smell, color = item
    checks = {
        'color not indigo': color != 'indigo',
        'size not extra-extra-large': size != 'extra-extra-large',
        'material not steel': material != 'steel',
        'smell not vanilla': smell != 'vanilla',
        'origin not Mexican': origin != 'Mexican'
    }
    all_pass = all(checks.values())
    if all_pass:
        matching_items_detail.append((name, origin, size, material, smell, color))

print(f"Total matching items: {len(matching_items_detail)}\n")

# Group by name to show duplicates
from collections import defaultdict
by_name_origin = defaultdict(list)
for name, origin, size, material, smell, color in matching_items_detail:
    by_name_origin[(name, origin)].append((size, material, smell, color))

for (name, origin), variants in sorted(by_name_origin.items()):
    if len(variants) > 1:
        print(f"{name} ({origin}): {len(variants)} copies")
        for size, material, smell, color in variants:
            print(f"    - {size}, {material}, {smell}, {color}")
    else:
        size, material, smell, color = variants[0]
        print(f"{name} ({origin}): 1 copy - {size}, {material}, {smell}, {color}")

print(f"\n=== FINAL ANSWER: {len(matching_items_detail)} ===")
